resources.string: 104 objects: more moons, probes, stars, galaxies and their central black holes.
Graphics pack 1.5: 56 external images and 56 lightweight previews, downloaded individually and cached offline.
Pause time at 0×; re-enabling acceleration starts at 1×. Resume options are in Custom scenario.
Types ordered by object count, alphabetical sorting options and clearer object controls.
Steadier reference labels and Nadir at −90°, opposite Zenith.
Improved moon motion, selected-object close approaches and explicit weather-loading status.
